rationale: The assistant correctly identified the split hose as the cause, proposed a proportionate tape test that the customer effectively confirmed ('Covering the split with my hand makes suction much better'), and recommended the justified NV602UK hose, sensibly handling the hose-only vs handle-assembly uncertainty with concrete ordering advice and a pointer to Shark UK. Calibration was good ('Very likely yes') and it did not repeat steps or invent customer facts. Minor deductions: no reminder to unplug before fitting, and the casual claim that NV600/NV601 hoses are 'compatible' is not fully substantiated, though the model was established.
